run_QAT_callback: create a QuantizationAwareTraining callback to enable quantization-aware training on a PyTorch Lightning model
run_PTQ_callback: create a PostTrainingQuantization callback to quantize a trained model using validation data for calibration
build_QAT_from_config: build a QuantizationAwareTraining callback from a D2Go CfgNode config with QAT settings
build_PTQ_from_config: build a PostTrainingQuantization callback from a D2Go CfgNode config with quantization module settings
test_requires_calibration: test whether a set of QConfigDicts requires calibration by checking for static quant types
